common.loadError: This information couldn’t be loaded. Try again.
common.offline: You’re offline. Connect to load the latest information.
common.noHub: Your account isn’t linked to a hub. Ask your hub admin.
common.notFound: This isn’t available at your hub, or the link is out of date.
common.notConnected: This build isn’t connected to the academy, so this can’t be shown.
common.synthetic: Synthetic preview data — not real people or records.

today.title: Today
today.scanHint: Opens the camera to check a cadet in
today.noBackend: Scanning needs a build connected to the academy.
today.notInstructor: Only instructors record check-ins and sessions.
today.rosterHint: Every cadet at your hub with today’s attendance
today.careOff: Care tasks aren’t connected in this build yet.
today.noCare: Nothing is assigned to you today.

scan.title: Check in
scan.cameraA11y: Camera view for scanning the passport QR
scan.frameHint: Hold the passport QR inside the frame.
scan.notPassport: This QR isn’t a Black Stallion passport.
scan.codeHint: Printed under the QR on the passport.
scan.codeFormat: That doesn’t look like a passport code, for example BSAH-26-F3A00001.
scan.unconnected: This build isn’t connected to the academy, so check-ins can’t be recorded.
scan.primerReason: The camera reads the QR on the cadet’s leather passport. Nothing from the camera is recorded or saved.
scan.cameraBlockedTitle: Camera is off for Black Stallion
scan.cameraBlocked: Turn the camera on in your phone’s settings to scan, or type the code printed under the QR.
scan.cameraUnavailable: This device can’t open a camera here. On a phone with the app, scanning uses the back camera. You can type the code instead.
scan.cameraFailed: Close the scanner and open it again, or type the code.
scan.devHint: Synthetic codes for the preview data only. Not in release builds.

result.notOnList: No cadet with this passport code at your hub. Check the passport, or ask your hub admin.
result.wrongDay: This check-in is filed under {{date}}, not today, so it can’t be assessed here. Check this phone’s date and ask your hub admin.

assess.title: Assessment
assess.draftKept: Kept on this phone while the app is open. Families see nothing until you publish.
assess.skillsNone: No skills are set up yet
assess.skillsNoneBody: The skills list is waiting for academy approval (D16). Scores and notes publish without it.
assess.skillsFailed: The skills list couldn’t be loaded. Scores and notes publish without it.
assess.clipBody: Up to 10 seconds, silent. Shown only to this cadet’s family.
assess.recordingOff: Recording is off — no training-video consent
assess.consentUnknown: Video consent couldn’t be checked, so recording stays off. Scores and notes still publish.
assess.consentWithdrawn: Video consent is no longer given, so the clip was removed and not sent.
assess.noVideoRole: Your account can’t record session clips.
assess.clipNoUpload: Clip upload isn’t connected in this build. Scores and notes still publish.
assess.clipNotSent: Sent with the scores when you publish.
assess.openFromTodayBody: Check the cadet in first, then choose Assess.
assess.notConnected: This build isn’t connected to the academy, so sessions can’t be published.

seal.title: Published
seal.body: {{name}}’s family can see this session now.

record.title: Published session
record.notRecorder: Only the instructor who recorded this session can correct it.

correct.title: Correct this session
correct.body: Change the scores or notes. The original stays in the history and the family sees that it was corrected.
correct.unchanged: Change a score or the notes first.
correct.doneBody: Version {{version}} is what the family sees now.

conflict.title: This record changed
conflict.body: Someone changed this session after you opened it (now version {{version}}). Your correction was not saved and nothing was overwritten.
conflict.reapply: Correct the latest version with my values
conflict.reloadFailed: The latest version couldn’t be loaded. Your correction is still not saved.

reason.correctionBody: The family sees that this session was corrected. Your reason is kept in the academy’s history.
reason.label: Reason
reason.short: Give a reason of at least {{min}} characters.

cadets.title: Cadets
cadets.noMatch: No cadet at your hub matches “{{query}}”.
cadets.denied: Your role doesn’t include cadet records. Ask your hub admin if you need them.
cadets.unavailable: Cadet records aren’t connected in this build.

profile.title: Cadet
profile.consentNote: Set by the family. “Couldn’t check” counts as off.
profile.historyHidden: Assessment history is visible to instructors.
profile.notFound: This cadet isn’t at your hub, or the link is out of date.
profile.voidHint: गलत पासपोर्ट स्कैन होने पर इसका उपयोग करें। तब कैडेट आज चेक-इन नहीं माना जाएगा।
profile.voidBody: चेक-इन अकादमी के इतिहास में आपके कारण के साथ रद्द के रूप में रहती है। केवल आज की बिना आकलन वाली चेक-इन रद्द हो सकती हैं।
profile.voided: चेक-इन रद्द हुई। {{name}} आज चेक-इन नहीं हैं।
profile.voidNotOffered: इस बिल्ड में रद्द करना उपलब्ध नहीं है।
profile.rankProposeHint: निर्णय के लिए रैंक प्राधिकारी को भेजा जाता है। स्वीकृति तक कुछ नहीं बदलता।

primer.sessionVideo: The camera records a silent clip of up to 10 seconds for this cadet’s family. Nothing is recorded until you press record.
primer.carePhoto: The camera takes a live proof photo for this care task. Photos can’t be picked from the gallery.
primer.shiftSelfie: The front camera takes one photo for your punch-in, if your hub asks for it.

capture.clipHint: Silent, up to {{max}} seconds. Recording stops by itself.
capture.photoHint: Frame the task and take the photo.
capture.noGallery: Live camera only — photos can’t be picked from the gallery.
capture.notUploaded: Not sent yet. It goes with the task when you submit.

failed.interrupted: Recording stopped before it finished. Nothing was kept; record again.
failed.capture: The photo couldn’t be taken. Try again.
failed.mount: The camera couldn’t start. Close and try again.

capture.expired: Go back and start again from the task.
capture.consent: This cadet’s family hasn’t allowed training videos, so the camera won’t record.
capture.unavailable: Capture runs in the phone app. This device or preview can’t open the camera.
capture.blockedTitle: Camera is off for Black Stallion
capture.blocked: Turn the camera on in your phone’s settings, then come back.
capture.devPlaceholder: Development: attach a synthetic placeholder (no real media)

roster.title: Session roster
roster.off: Your academy hasn’t turned on session rosters (decision Q7/D31 pending). Use Today and Cadets instead.
roster.empty: Cadets appear here when they are enrolled at your hub.

permissions.osNext: Your phone asks next. You can change this later in its settings.

ask.title: Allow the camera?
ask.body: The camera is used for passport scans and for evidence you choose to capture.
ask.point1: Used only while a scan or capture screen is open.
ask.point2: Photos and clips stay private to the academy.

blocked.title: Camera is off for Black Stallion
blocked.body: Turn the camera on in your phone’s settings to continue. Nothing else changes.

unavailable.title: Camera not available
unavailable.body: This device or preview can’t use a camera here.

ask.title: Allow the microphone?
ask.body: The microphone is used only while you record, and only if your academy turns sound on.
ask.point2: Recordings stay private to the academy.

blocked.title: Microphone is off for Black Stallion
blocked.body: Turn the microphone on in your phone’s settings to continue.

unavailable.title: Microphone not available
unavailable.body: This device or preview can’t use a microphone here.

ask.title: Allow location?
ask.body: Your location is attached to this record so your hub can confirm where it happened.
ask.point1: Read once, when you submit — never in the background.
ask.point2: Weak or missing location goes to your hub for review; it never blocks your work.

blocked.title: Location is off for Black Stallion
blocked.body: Turn location on in your phone’s settings, or continue without it and your hub will review the record.

unavailable.title: Location not available
unavailable.body: This device can’t provide a location here.

errors.clockSkew: This phone’s date or time is wrong, so nothing was recorded. Set the date and time to automatic, then try again.
errors.shape: The academy sent an answer this app doesn’t understand. Nothing is confirmed.
errors.clipRead: The clip on this phone couldn’t be read. Record it again.

known.notAllowed: Your account can’t do this. Ask your hub admin if you think it should.
known.noCadetAtHub: No cadet with this passport code at your hub. Check the code or ask your hub admin.
known.clockRefused: This phone’s clock looks wrong, so the check-in was refused. Set the date and time automatically, then try again.
known.opReused: This request clashed with an earlier one. Try again.
known.checkInGone: This check-in isn’t at your hub any more.
known.cadetMoved: This cadet has moved to another hub, so the session can’t be published here.
known.scoresRange: Riding, ground and stable scores must be whole numbers from 1 to 10.
known.skillRetired: One of the skills is no longer in use. Remove it and try again.
known.videoMissing: The video must finish uploading first.
known.reasonLength: Give a reason of 3 to 500 characters.
known.sessionNotFound: This record isn’t available at your hub.
known.nothingToCorrect: Nothing changed, so there is nothing to correct.
known.notRecorder: Only the instructor who recorded this session can correct it. Ask your hub admin.
known.staleVersion: Someone changed this record since you opened it. Nothing was overwritten.
known.voidPastDay: यहाँ केवल आज की चेक-इन रद्द की जा सकती हैं। पुरानी के लिए अपने हब एडमिन से पूछें।
known.alreadyVoided: यह चेक-इन पहले ही रद्द हो चुकी है।
known.voidPublished: इस चेक-इन का आकलन पहले ही प्रकाशित है। इसके बजाय सुधार करें।
known.checkInVoided: यह चेक-इन रद्द कर दी गई थी, इसलिए इसका आकलन नहीं हो सकता।
known.checkInVoidedToday: इस कैडेट की आज की चेक-इन रद्द की गई थी, इसलिए आज दोबारा चेक-इन नहीं हो सकता। अपने हब एडमिन से पूछें।

forbidden.checkIn: Your account can’t record check-ins. Ask your hub admin.
forbidden.publish: Your account can’t publish sessions. Ask your hub admin.
forbidden.correct: Your account can’t correct this session. Ask your hub admin.
forbidden.void: आपका खाता चेक-इन रद्द नहीं कर सकता। अपने हब एडमिन से पूछें।

notFound.publish: This check-in isn’t at your hub any more.
notFound.correct: This record isn’t available at your hub.
notFound.void: यह चेक-इन अब आपके हब पर नहीं है।

conflict.checkIn: This clashed with another change. Try again.
conflict.publish: This clashed with another change. Reload and try again.
conflict.correct: This record changed since you opened it. Nothing was overwritten.
conflict.void: खोलने के बाद यह चेक-इन बदल गई। फिर से लोड करके देखें।

invalid.checkIn: The check-in was refused. Check the code and try again.
invalid.publish: The session was refused. Check the scores and try again.
invalid.correct: The correction was refused. Check the scores and reason.
invalid.load: Something isn’t right with this request.
invalid.void: रद्द करना अस्वीकार हुआ। कारण जाँचकर फिर कोशिश करें।

network.checkIn: We couldn’t confirm the check-in. Try again — repeating it is safe and won’t check the cadet in twice.
network.publish: We couldn’t confirm publishing. Try again — repeating it is safe and won’t publish twice.
network.correct: We couldn’t confirm the correction. Try again — repeating it is safe and won’t apply it twice.
network.load: We couldn’t reach the academy. Check your connection and try again.
network.void: हम रद्द करने की पुष्टि नहीं कर सके। फिर कोशिश करें — दोहराना सुरक्षित है और दो बार रद्द नहीं होगा।

signedOut.checkIn: Your session ended. Sign in again.
signedOut.publish: Your session ended. Sign in again, then re-enter the scores.
signedOut.correct: Your session ended. Sign in again, then make the correction again.
signedOut.load: Your session ended. Sign in again.
signedOut.void: आपका सत्र समाप्त हो गया। फिर से साइन इन करें, फिर चेक-इन दोबारा रद्द करें।

unexpected.checkIn: Something went wrong. Nothing is confirmed yet; try again.
unexpected.publish: Something went wrong. Nothing is confirmed yet; try again.
unexpected.correct: Something went wrong. Nothing is confirmed yet; try again.
unexpected.void: कुछ गड़बड़ हुई। अभी कुछ भी पक्का नहीं है; फिर कोशिश करें।
